messages.subject: [Rpy] rpy2-2.4.0 is released
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

rpy2-2.4.0 is now on Pypi: pip install rpy2 --upgrade

The list of user-visible changes is rather short, but a lot was done 
behind the scene to improve rpy2.
http://rpy.sourceforge.net/rpy2/doc-2.4/html/changes.html#release-2-4-0

Thanks to Dav Clark, Thomas Kluyver, and Pablo Oliveira for migrating 
the ipython "R magic" from the ipython code base to rpy2, and to 
everyone who helped along with pull requests, bug reports, or comments.

Bitbucket does not show a list of contributors, so use Ohloh to have the 
list of recent contributors:
http://www.ohloh.net/p/rpy2/contributors?sort=latest_commit&time_span=12+months



Best,

Laurent
